description: Full-text search inside SEC filings: the words a company itself wrote in its 10-K and 10-Q (business, properties, risk factors, MD&A), 20-F, and 8-K filings with their press releases. Returns the matching passage, company, form, filing date, section and a link to the exact filing on EDGAR. Use it for questions like "which banks mention contact centers in their 10-K", "did Verizon talk about headcount this year", "who is opening a new facility", or to search only the user's watchlist. Plain phrases match as a whole phrase plus common synonyms (contact center also finds call center). Put words in quotes, use OR, or a leading minus for exact control. Public companies only; covers the last 12 months.

company_name.description: Limit to companies whose SEC name contains this (partial, case-insensitive), e.g. "verizon"

page.description: Page number, starting at 1 (default 1). Each page holds `limit` filings; the reply ends with the total and next_page when there are more.

query.description: Words or phrase to find, e.g. "contact center", "offshore", "new facility", "headcount"

section.description: Optional 10-K item ("1" business, "1A" risk factors, "2" properties, "7" MD&A) or 10-Q item ("I-2" MD&A, "II-1A" risk factors)

watchlist.description: Limit to companies on the signed-in user's Fundz watchlist

name: search_filing_text
title: Search inside SEC filings
